native_failures.stderr_key: OMP: Error #15: Initializing libomp.dylib, but found libomp.dylib already initialized.

interpretation: Fresh minimal error identifies duplicate OpenMP initialization in this environment. It is consistent with the earlier native crash/hang but does not prove every crash has the identical root cause. We do not use the unsafe KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK suggestion printed by the runtime.
